_comment.auth_method: OAuth flow method: 'local_server' (opens browser, needs redirect URI registered) or 'console' (prints URL, no redirect URI needed).
_comment.client_secrets_file: Path to Google OAuth 2.0 client secrets JSON (YouTube Data API v3 credentials).
_comment.clips_dir: Directory containing per-clip JSON metadata files and matching MP4 videos.
_comment.csv_file: CSV file with video metadata (consumed via csv.DictReader). Rows with is_processed=1 are skipped on re-runs; the script updates is_processed and video_id after each successful upload. Replaces the old 'csv_out' key — both now unify to 'csv_file'.
_comment.field_mapping: Maps CSV output columns to source JSON keys. Use 'key:join:sep' syntax to join list values (e.g. hashtags:join:,). The 'is_processed' column defaults to 0 (unprocessed); app.py only uploads rows where is_processed=0 and flips it to 1 (processed) after a successful upload, storing the YouTube video_id. Re-running app.py is safe — processed rows are skipped.
_comment.file_name_pattern: Pattern to build video file name from JSON stem; placeholders {stem} and {ext} supported (default: {stem}). File_name_pattern controls how the MP4 filename is built from each clip JSON's stem. {stem} — the JSON filename without extension (e.g. 'clip01' from 'clip01.json') {ext}  — the original file extension (e.g. '.json' from 'clip01.json') The pattern is formatted with {stem} and {ext}, then video_ext (.mp4) is appended. Default '{stem}' + '.mp4' produces 'clip01.mp4'. Use this if your MP4s don't share the exact same stem as your JSON files.
_comment.glob_pattern: Glob pattern used to find clip metadata JSON files (default: clip*.json).
_comment.list_channels: If true, lists all channels the authenticated user owns/manages and exits. Use --list-channels CLI flag to see available channels when the Google account has multiple YouTube channels.
_comment.oauth_port: Local server port for OAuth callback (0 = random available port). Must match a redirect URI registered in Google Cloud Console (e.g. http://localhost:8080).
_comment.repo_dir: Target repository directory (contains app.py and where videos/ + CSV will be written).
_comment.schedule_timings: List of [hour, minute] UTC times for each video within a batch, applied in order.
_comment.set_size: Number of videos to upload per batch (one batch per day).
_comment.token_file: Path to stored OAuth token file (created automatically on first auth).
_comment.video_category: YouTube category ID for uploaded videos (15 = Pets & Animals; see catogory.txt for full list).
_comment.video_directory: Directory containing MP4 video files to upload (relative to repo root). Used by both convert_clips.py (staging MP4s here) and app.py (reading MP4s from here). Replaces the old 'videos_dir' key — both now unify to 'video_directory'.
_comment.video_ext: File extension of the video files to copy alongside each JSON (default: .mp4).
_comment.youtube_readonly_scope: OAuth scope(s) for read-only YouTube access (needed to list channels). Combined with upload scope for OAuth flow.
_comment.youtube_upload_scope: OAuth scope(s) requested for YouTube upload access.
